name: W3C PROV-O / RDF
abstract: The RDF binding of the W3C PROV data model via the PROV Ontology (PROV-O), serializable as Turtle, N-Triples, RDF/XML, N-Quads, TriG, etc. A profile of the W3C PROV Representation Base.

sources.title: OGC API - Processes - Part 5: Provenance (registers `text/turtle` for PROV-TURTLE and `application/n-triples` for PROV-NT)
